{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|It is an ancient Hapan defense—and it leads to the only place I can ever be truly alone.|Tenel Ka Djo to Jacen Solo|<ref name="Dark Nest I: The Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>}}
'''The Secret Way''' was a passageway that led to an island, and was not used very often. [[Paan tree]]s were found on the island. In [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]], [[Tenel Ka Djo]] took [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] to the island for some privacy using the Secret Way.
